query:
SELECT now() checked_at_utc,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) migrations,
 (SELECT version FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations WHERE name='retire_journey_simulation_bot') retirement_version,
 public.runtime_schema_compatibility() compatibility,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'paused',paused,'next_run_at',next_run_at,'run_until',run_until)) FROM public.journey_bot_configs) configs,
 (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(table_name,row_count) FROM (SELECT 'configs' table_name,count(*) row_count FROM public.journey_bot_configs UNION ALL SELECT 'runs',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_runs UNION ALL SELECT 'children',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_child_journeys UNION ALL SELECT 'events',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_child_events UNION ALL SELECT 'issues',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_issues UNION ALL SELECT 'purges',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_purge_receipts) t) retained_row_counts,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',s,'absent',to_regprocedure(s) IS NULL)) FROM unnest(ARRAY['public.claim_journey_bot_config(uuid,uuid,integer)','app_private.claim_journey_bot_config(uuid,uuid,integer)','public.purge_journey_bot_run(uuid,uuid)','app_private.purge_journey_bot_run(uuid,uuid)']) s) procedures,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t,'role',r,'writable',has_table_privilege(r,'public.'||t,'insert,update,delete,truncate,references,trigger'),'readable',has_table_privilege(r,'public.'||t,'select'))) FROM unnest(ARRAY['journey_bot_configs','journey_bot_runs','journey_bot_child_journeys','journey_bot_child_events','journey_bot_issues','journey_bot_purge_receipts']) t CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['anon','authenticated','service_role']) r) privileges,
 md5(pg_get_functiondef('app_private.prevent_swim_lifecycle_event_mutation()'::regprocedure)) lifecycle_guard_md5;
